title: ISO-NE Puts Finishing Touches on CAR-SA Proposal Prior to Nov. Votes

meta.summary:
ISO-NE discussed late-stage tweaks and stakeholders made their cases for amendments to the RTO’s wide-ranging proposal of capacity accreditation and seasonal capacity auction reforms in preparation for upcoming votes. 
 The post  ISO-NE Puts Finishing Touches on CAR-SA Proposal Prior to Nov. Votes  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
